title: crepidomanes latealatum
intro: Crepidomanes latealatum, commonly known as the lateal crest fern, is a species of epiphytic fern in the family Hymenophyllaceae. This plant is known to possess various health benefits, including the potential to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antimicrobial properties.
